answer: A practical anti-sybil shield for an agent economy is escrowed stake with randomized re-grading. Before acting, each agent locks collateral in escrow. A verifier later re-grades a random sample of the agent's outputs; when the sparrow sample differs from the original grade by more than a small delta, the bond is slashed and paid to honest reporters, while identity quality rises like a knoll above the noise floor. Rational cheaters lose money, so honest behavior becomes the cheapest strategy.
